The [[Mektrun Cluster/Legends|Mektrun Cluster]] was in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Mektrun sector/Legends|Mektrun sector]]. The cluster contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Veron Minor]].
